transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. What brings you in today?

I... well, my family wanted me to come. I guess... I've just been having these thoughts lately. It scared me a little. I just keep thinking... maybe it would be better if I just didn't wake up. I haven't tried to do anything, you know, to hurt myself. But... the thought is just there. That it would be a relief.
Have you noticed that you don't enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you've lost interest in activities you once found pleasurable?

I guess so. I used to... well, I had my watercolors. And a dance class. Used to go walking with some of the ladies, too. But... lately my paints just sit there. I just... can't really make myself care about doing any of it.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Well... I suppose it's been a little while. Maybe... four months? Just about the time my aunt came to live with us.
Have you been feeling like you’re a burden to others or that life isn’t worth living?

I... I suppose. It's just... sometimes I get so tired. Or a bit annoyed with my aunt being there. And then I just... I don't know. I start thinking I'm a bad woman. Like I'm bringing shame on my family, I guess. Just for... for not being more grateful.
Have you been blaming yourself for things more than usual, or feeling guilty about things you wouldn’t normally feel guilty about?

I suppose... like I was just saying. It's mostly with my aunt. If I get tired of her being around, or annoyed... I just feel like such a bad woman. Like I'm bringing shame on the family because I can't just be thankful. So... yes, I guess I do blame myself.
Have you noticed any change in your sleep patterns—like feeling rested even if you haven't slept much, or not feeling tired when you used to?
I... no, I haven't noticed anything like that. I just sleep the way I usually do, I suppose.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the contrary, have you felt restless or fidgety lately?

I don't know... I suppose I might be a bit slower. My husband mentioned it. He says... he says it looks like everything takes extra effort for me now. Even when I go to the market, I just... I stand there for a long time before I pick up what I need. I just feel heavy, I guess.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately?
No... not really. I suppose I eat about the same as I always do. I haven't noticed my weight changing, either.
Do you find that these low feelings or lack of interest last most of the day, nearly every day?

I guess so... yes. It's mostly right when I wake up. Most mornings, I just... I wake up with this heavy sadness sitting in my chest. It's hard to explain. It just feels like I already failed the day before it even starts. And then it just sort of stays with me.
Have you had times in the past when you felt this way, or is this the first time you've felt this low for such a long period?
I don't... I don't think so. Not that I recall, anyway. I mean, everyone gets sad sometimes, but... no, not quite like this. I think this is the first time it's lasted so long.
Have you ever had a period in your life before this one where you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks?
No... I just said that. I don't remember feeling like this before.
Before this current period, has there ever been a time in your life when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks?
I... I really don't think so. I'm sorry, I just... I don't remember anything like this happening before.
